name: How do I choose the safest tile for a walk-in shower floor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the safest tile for a walk-in shower floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose slip-resistant floor tiles with a textured finish or small mosaic tiles that offer ample grout lines for traction. Wet bathroom floors pose slipping hazards, making polished stone or high-gloss porcelain unsuitable underfoot in walk-in showers. Look for tiles rated with a high Dynamic Coefficient of Friction (DCOF of 0.42 or higher for wet areas). Mosaic tiles, such as two-inch hexagons or pebbles, naturally provide reliable foot grip due to the dense grid of grout joints beneath your feet.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select textured tiles or small mosaics with a wet-rated slip resistance (DCOF 0.42 or higher), as frequent grout lines provide essential foot grip.
